name: Maacah (Princess of Geshur)
title: Geshurite Princess and Wife of David
summary: Maacah was the daughter of King Talmai of Geshur, a small Aramean kingdom east of Galilee. She became one of King David's wives and the mother of Absalom and Tamar. Through her children, she became involved in some of the most dramatic events at David's court.

keyEvents.title: Marriage to David
keyEvents.description: Maacah married David while he was king in Hebron, likely as part of a political alliance with Geshur.

keyEvents.title: Mother of Absalom and Tamar
keyEvents.description: Maacah gave birth to Absalom, who became known for his beauty and later rebelled against his father, and Tamar, who fell victim to the assault by her half-brother Amnon.

keyEvents.title: Absalom's Flight to Geshur
keyEvents.description: After Absalom killed Amnon to avenge his sister Tamar, he fled to his maternal grandfather Talmai in Geshur, showing the continued connection to Maacah's family.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in David's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Maacah and her son Absalom are mentioned in Chronicles' account of David's sons born in Hebron.
